items.claim: Aspen possesses a long jab and utilizes good volume in his striking.
items.quote: He's got a long jab. He's going to stick that jab out there... And he's got good volume to go with it.

items.claim: Aspen maintains a high output and reasonable pace even when experiencing fatigue, constituting good cardio for a heavyweight.
items.quote: Aspen's got pretty good cardio cardio for a heavyweight.

items.claim: Tai Miller's takedown defense effectively improves as the fight goes on because he forces opponents to work and tires them out.
items.quote: He's got good good enough takedown defense that seems to get better as the fight goes on.

items.claim: Billy Goff's striking defense is not great.
items.quote: His striking defense isn't great, but he's putting out a lot of output.

items.claim: Alexia Tanara holds a professional record of 14 wins and 1 loss.
items.quote: Alexia Tanara 14-1, 5-0 in the last five.
